titles.english: PERSONA5 the Animation: Stars and Ours

description:
The Phantom Thieves were successful in reforming the heart of Masayoshi Shido, the politician behind all of the disturbing cases. Yet, the public’s response sharply differed from what they had expected.

To correct the corruption of society and to achieve the justice they strongly believe in, Ren and the Phantom Thieves embark on their final battle.

Source: Crunchyroll
